verdict.rationale: Typesense's comparison pages say it offers native LLM integrations for Natural Language Search and built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Its docs cover semantic, vector and hybrid search as retrieval primitives, shown in a hybrid-search demo and a 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the conversational/RAG answer endpoint (parameters, conversation history, LLM configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG answer quality.
